fix_title: Fix zero register handling in servile_rf_mem_if module
reason: The pinned file zeroes the read of x31 instead of x0 (regzero <= &i_raddr[rf_depth-1:2]), so x0 reads whatever the SRAM word behind it holds. Found by the ISA suite producer: riscv-arch-test 3.9.1 I+Zifencei signatures against Spike match on 9 of 40 programs with the pinned file and on 40 of 40 with the upstream fix; on non-zero SRAM power-up (0xFF, 0xA5) the pinned file hangs even riscv-tests `simple`. The file at the fix commit's parent is byte-identical to the pinned one (sha256_before), so the fetched file is the pinned file plus exactly this fix.
